create_guidance_backend: create an llguidance constrained decoding backend with a tokenizer and whitespace configuration
build_json_schema_grammar: build a constrained grammar from a JSON schema string using the llguidance backend dispatch_json method
build_regex_grammar: build a constrained grammar from a regex pattern string using the llguidance backend dispatch_regex method
build_ebnf_grammar: build a constrained grammar from an EBNF grammar string using the llguidance backend dispatch_ebnf method
test_guidance_grammar_mask: test the GuidanceGrammar class to accept tokens, fill vocab masks, and apply token bitmasks during constrained decoding
